args.title: Ironbark returns blog + companion — summary
args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24%, making returns a major cost center in retail logistics.
- Consolidating return hubs cut handling cost by roughly a fifth (20%).
- Per the companion piece, reselling returned goods within 10 days preserved most of the margin.

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns and https://insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion
